title: observability pipeline debug notes - traces/metrics/logs wip
content:
Summary:
- Since ~2026-02-15 22:00 UTC we started seeing partial loss of spans for traffic routed through the west-2 region gateway. Metrics ingestion (prometheus -> metrics-store) shows a correlated 30-50% drop for a subset of infra and app metrics between 22:00-23:30 UTC. Logs ingestion delayed (high tails) for kafka topic observability-raw-logs.

What I observed (quick notes):
- Traces: service-level traces missing (no root spans) for services: api-gateway-west2, auth-svc, ratelimit-srv. Spans are present for east/asia routes.
- Metrics: scrape success rate unchanged, but exported samples to clickhouse show 35% fewer series for namespace=infra-west2.
- Logs: consumer lag on observability-raw-logs topic jumped to > 10M for partition 3 between 21:50-22:10 UTC, recovered partially after consumer restart.

Commands / checks I ran (timestamps local UTC):
1) Kafka lag (kafkactl):
$ kafkactl partitions -t observability-raw-logs -o json | jq '.[] | select(.partition==3) | {partition,lag,offset} ' 
{
  "partition": 3,
  "lag": 10345678,
  "offset": 987654321
}
Notes: confirms big lag spike.

2) Consumer group status:
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server brk-kafka-west2:9092 --describe --group obs-log-consumer
GROUP           TOPIC                 PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG       CONSUMER-ID
obs-log-consumer observability-raw-logs 3          987643210      998000000       10356790  consumer-01-west2

Consumer was stuck on older offset; consumer process was running but CPU stuck at ~5% for a while. Restarted obs-log-consumer on west2 (systemctl restart obs-log-consumer) -> consumer caught up slowly.

3) Ingestion worker logs (after restart):
2026-02-16T22:15:02Z [WARN] decoder: json decode error: unexpected EOF (span batch size: 0)
2026-02-16T22:15:02Z [ERROR] ingest: failed to write to clickhouse: Code: 62, message: "Memory limit exceeded on server"
2026-02-16T22:15:05Z [INFO] consumer: processing resumed, lag decreased to 1M

Hypothesis: a downstream ClickHouse node hit a memory pressure OOM/soft-fail around 21:50 UTC, causing ingestion to backpressure and consumers to fall behind; backpressure also caused sampling/batching changes leading to missing spans (sampler dropping root spans).

4) ClickHouse cluster check (clickhouse-client):
$ clickhouse-client --host clickhouse-west2 --query "SELECT host, metric, value FROM system.metrics WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR"
host	metric	value
ch-west2-01	MemoryTracking	1.9e+10
ch-west2-02	MemoryTracking	2.1e+10
ch-west2-03	MemoryTracking	2.4e+10
Notes: ch-west2-03 above expected threshold (2.0e+10). I requested storage team to check page cache and oversized merges.

5) Jaeger/Tracing query (es-backed):
$ curl -s 'https://jaeger-west2.internal/api/traces?service=api-gateway-west2&end=...&limit=20' | jq '.data | length'
0
But other services return > 10 traces.

6) Repro attempt (manual span push):
$ curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data @test-span.json https://ingest-west2.internal/v1/spans
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
Body: {"received":1,"dropped":1,"reason":"root_span_missing"}
Snippet from test-span.json:
{
  "traces": [ {"spans": [{"span_id":"1","parent_id":null,"operation":"test","service":"api-gateway-west2","start":1676540000}] } ]
}
So ingest pipeline explicitly dropped span: reason root_span_missing. That aligns with sampler/transform stage returning an error for a subset of spans.

7) Ingest service logs (transform stage):
2026-02-15T21:59:58Z [ERROR] transform: span validation failed: missing serviceName (raw payload had service null)
2026-02-15T21:59:58Z [WARN] sampler: sample rate override applied for route /v1/gateway (rate=0.0)

Hypothesis 2: a recent deploy to api-gateway-west2 (2026-02-15 21:40 UTC) introduced a change where telemetry lib stops setting serviceName for a subset of requests (edge case with HTTP/2 multiplexing). This caused transform to drop spans and sampler to set rate=0 for safety, further reducing stored traces.

Related deploy: git rev: a7c9f1e (deploy to api-gateway-west2 @ 2026-02-15 21:38)
Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api-gateway/pull/1124 (changes to http2 handler, telemetry wrapper)

Quick recall / timeline:
- 21:35 UTC: deploy api-gateway-west2 a7c9f1e
- 21:40 UTC: CH merge/major compaction observed on ch-west2-03 (storage team)
- 21:50 UTC: consumer lag spike / clickhouse mem errors / transform errors start

Actions taken so far:
- Restarted obs-log-consumer and obs-ingest-transformers on west2 -> partial catch-up and transient improvement (2026-02-16 22:20).
- Rolled back api-gateway-west2 to previous telemetry wrapper (rollback to a7b8d3c) on 2026-02-16 23:00 for canary hosts. Observability sampling/trace counts improved on canary, but not global.
- Opened INC-4721 (on-call) and pinged storage team re: CH compaction/merges on ch-west2-03.

Commands I haven't tried yet (next steps):
- Increase clickhouse memory.limit temporary on ch-west2-03 OR disable big merges during peak window (coord with storage).
- Run a synthetic stream with enforced serviceName to confirm sampler behavior end-to-end: push 10k spans/sec for 10m to ingest-west2 and measure accepted/dropped.
- Add additional logging in transform stage to dump first 50 problematic payloads (sanitized) to s3 for offline analysis (need approval).
- Check telemetry lib version across canary vs all hosts:
$ kubectl -n gateway get deploy api-gateway-west2 -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}'
Image: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/api-gateway:release-2026-02-15-a7c9f1e

Notes / random observations:
- Some traces show serviceName present when sampled via east region -> implies gateway client behavior differs by route (maybe gateway proxy sets header only for routed host header).
- There are "http 413 Payload too large" warnings in ingest logs prior to the memory errors; could be batching pushing large batches to CH and CH rejecting them -> results in backpressure.
- Metrics drop is concentrated on metrics with label region=west2 and exporter=go-metrics-pusher. The exporter in go-metrics v1.12.0 did get a change in how host labels are set (PR #578 in metrics repo).

Minimally viable mitigation (short term):
- Temporarily increase transformer logging and set sampler default to 0.1 for west2 to avoid full rate=0. (careful: may increase CH load).
- Throttle traffic to west2 or route a percentage to east for critical services until CH compaction/memory issue resolved.

Questions for storage / infra teams:
- Can storage team check for OOM/killed processes or metrics around merges on ch-west2-03 for 21:30-22:30 UTC 2026-02-15?
- Any known scheduled compaction/maintenance around that time?
- Can we temporarily bump memory.limit or add a replica to absorb merges?

Short-term todo (owner: Eli):
- [ ] Add temporary debug logging in transform (PR draft) -> link to draft PR when created
- [ ] Coordinate with storage team to get CH diagnostics -> attach results to INC-4721
- [ ] Run synthetic spans push to validate sampler fix -> record results
- [ ] Triage api-gateway PR #1124 changes to telemetry wrapper with @Priya

If stuck: escalate to on-call lead (Amelia) and SRE infra team.

Appendix: snippets
- sample dropped response from ingest: {"received":5120,"dropped":3045,"reasons":{"root_span_missing":2980,"validation_error":65}}
- sample transform stacktrace:
  runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer deref
  goroutine 1189 [running]:
  github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/transform.(*Transformer).Process(0xc0002a4000, 0xc000b8a000)
      /workspace/ingest/transform/transformer.go:214 +0x8c3

- test span payload used for repro (sanitized): {"traces":[{"spans":[{"trace_id":"aa...","span_id":"1","operation":"healthcheck","service":"api-gateway-west2","start":1676540000,"duration_ms":12}]}]}

I'll update this doc as new logs/answers come in. Priority: P1 (impacting visibility for production west2).

---
Notes history: copied into INC-4721 and into the incident channel on Slack.
